story.iWant: to check the Verified KB BEFORE generating new answers
story.tasks:
- [ ] **Task 1: Two-Stage Retrieval Pipeline** (AC: #1, #2, #3) - [ ] Add pre-RAG lookup against `verified_qa` index scoped by tenant/group/bot - [ ] Return verified answer payload when similarity >= threshold - [ ] Bypass LLM generation and document retrieval on verified hit - [ ] Fall back to existing RAG path when no verified match
- [ ] **Task 2: Similarity & Thresholding** (AC: #2, #3) - [ ] Use cosine similarity on `question_embedding` with default threshold 0.95 - [ ] Make threshold configurable per environment with sane defaults - [ ] Add safety check to avoid empty/zero vectors - [ ] Log scored candidates for observability (no PII)
- [ ] **Task 3: Response & UI Signal** (AC: #2) - [ ] Include `verified=true` flag and provenance in API response - [ ] Display "Verified" badge in chat/message UI when flag is set - [ ] Add response metadata: matched question id, confidence score, source citations
- [ ] **Task 4: Performance & Caching** (AC: #4) - [ ] Measure retrieval latency and ensure <50ms budget for verified lookup - [ ] Add optional in-memory cache for hot verified questions (scope-aware) - [ ] Add tracing spans/metrics for verified path vs standard RAG path
- [ ] **Task 5: Testing** (AC: all) - [ ] Unit tests for similarity thresholding and branching logic - [ ] Integration test: verified match skips LLM generation - [ ] Integration test: fallback to RAG when no verified match - [ ] Performance test: verified lookup stays within latency budget - [ ] UI test: "Verified" badge renders only when verified flag is true

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** a user query **When** the RAG pipeline runs **Then** the Verified KB is searched FIRST
2. **Given** a semantic match with confidence > 95% **Then** the verified answer is returned immediately **And** the "Verified" badge is displayed **And** no LLM generation occurs
3. **Given** no match in Verified KB **Then** the standard RAG pipeline continues **And** answer may be generated from documents
4. **Verified KB search adds <50ms latency** end-to-end for retrieval path

story-context.constraints: - Verified lookup must precede document retrieval and generation; no LLM call on verified hit. - Apply tenant_id/group_id/bot_id filters in verified_qa query to maintain isolation. - Default similarity threshold 0.95; configurable but cannot be lowered without risk assessment. - Latency budget: keep verified path <50ms; add tracing to monitor.
